chapter: Corrections and views on early Black music
title: Library of music and corrections to a published story about White
summary: After a tape break the talk turns to his music library and errors in an earlier article, such as being a night watchman or jailed.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Oh no, you wouldn't want to travel around anymore now. You wouldn't want to travel all over the country. No, I wouldn't want to. Although you certainly look young and active, you could do it if you'd like to do it too.

I'd like for you to go downstairs and see my wonderful library down there. I think really I've got a library of music down there that's creditable. We do want to go down. See how much I've got anyhow. You couldn't appraise it. I can't appraise it myself.

Oh no, you can't figure that. No. I'm wondering, just about you here, if there's anything else, there's one thing we might, any other corrections to that other story that was published about you. For instance, the one thing, you were never a night watchman. No, I never was a night watchman.
Any other errors that you wanted to make a note of? Yeah, and I never was in any jail for any length of time for any conviction to come upon me.
